theater: 阿拉伯半島北境與敘利亞

battle.name: 穆斯林
battle.theater: 阿拉伯半島北境與敘利亞
battle.brief: 公元622年，穆罕默德自麥加遷往麥地那，伊斯蘭曆由此起算；阿拉伯聯盟在626年遠征塔布克、於希拉河擊潰拜占庭與加沙尼聯軍，628年又與拜占庭停戰聯手對付薩珊，630年統一阿拉伯半島。卡面的秦連弩屬中國弩機兵器，與本役相隔八百餘年，並未出現在黎凡特戰場。

kit.name: 秦連弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，一踩一發。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 這場戰爭是阿拉伯部落聯盟（622年後即拉希敦哈里發國）對拜占庭帝國與薩珊波斯的戰爭，起於622年，延伸到630年前後。阿拉伯一方以麥加、麥地那為基地，兵源是逐漸歸附的部落聯盟，總指揮權集中於穆罕默德一身；622年之後設立哈里發制，阿布·伯克爾與歐麥爾先後接掌，各支軍隊以黑旗、白旗等旗幟相別，師團之間相距數十里、各自為戰，統兵者多為部族首領。拜占庭一方在敘利亞與埃及有常駐軍團與徵收網絡，敘利亞前線由皇帝赫拉克里乌斯與其弟梅爾基亞、太子赫拉克里乌斯分頭掌控，實際作戰多由拜占庭將軍與其阿拉伯盟友加沙尼人首領加瓦爾·本·哈瓦里特指揮。薩珊波斯此時正捲入與拜占庭長達二十六年的邊境戰爭：霍斯勞二世於619年攻入埃及、613至619年間奪去敘利亞與耶路撒冷，拜占庭皇帝赫拉克里乌斯自622年回師反攻，628年在尼尼微重創波斯軍，但薩珊隨即因宮變與王位爭奪而崩潰。兩個帝國兩敗俱傷，正是阿拉伯聯盟得以在北方邊境放手施展的縫隙。
countriesEn: This war was fought by the Arab tribal confederation — the Rashidun caliphate from 622 onward — against the Byzantine Empire and the Sasanian Empire, beginning in 622 and running to around 630. The Arab side was based at Mecca and Medina, drew its men from a coalition of tribes that came over one by one, and kept supreme command in the hands of Muhammad alone; after 622 the office of caliph was created, Abu Bakr and Umar took it in turn, and the field armies were told apart by black and white banners, marched tens of li apart and fought on their own, most of them commanded by tribal chiefs. The Byzantine side held permanent garrisons and a fiscal network in Syria and Egypt; the Syrian front was shared by the emperor Heraclius, his brother Mercurius and his son Heraclius the Younger, while the actual fighting was usually done by Byzantine generals together with the Arab allies of the empire, the Ghassanids led by Ghawwar ibn al-Huwarith. The Sasanian Empire at that moment was already in the middle of a twenty-six-year border war with Byzantium: Khosrow II had taken Egypt in 619 and stripped Syria and Jerusalem from the Romans between 613 and 619, and Heraclius turned back from the Persian front in 622 and counter-attacked, mauling the Persian army at Nineveh in 628 — but the Persians were then torn apart by palace coup and dynastic strife. Two empires bled dry at the same time, and that was the crack in the northern frontier through which the Arab coalition could act.
people: 決定這場戰爭走向的是穆罕默德（約570至632年），麥加出身，610年開始宣講新信仰，622年7月遷往麥地那，此後以麥地那為基地組織部落聯盟，626年遠征塔布克、深入敘利亞邊境，630年基本統一阿拉伯半島，632年6月病逝。哈里發制建立後，第一任哈里發阿布·伯克爾（573至634年）主持對外攻勢，遣軍深入拜占庭與波斯國境；第二任哈里發歐麥爾（634至644年）以行政與財政手腕鞏固征服成果。戰場上最著名的是哈立德·伊本·瓦利德，人稱「敘利亞的劍」，以騎射與夜間急行軍著稱，指揮迦珊戰役、大馬士革之役與葉爾穆克戰役；阿穆爾·伊本·阿斯攻取埃及，祖拜爾·伊本·阿瓦德開闢通往埃及的西路。拜占庭方面的關鍵人物是皇帝赫拉克里乌斯，他以自波斯戰線回師、收復安條克、深入美索不達米亞再折返君士坦丁堡的一連串機動拖垮了波斯；其弟梅爾基亞與太子赫拉克里乌斯在首都與西線分兵；加沙尼人首領加瓦爾·本·哈瓦里特是阿拉伯人眼中「羅馬人的走狗」。薩珊方面的霍斯勞二世、沙赫斯魯與皮魯茲父子，則把這個帝國推向了崩潰。
peopleEn: The man who decided the course of this war was Muhammad (c. 570 to 632), a Meccan who began preaching his new faith in 610 and who moved to Medina in July 622, making the town the base from which he organised a tribal confederation; he campaigned deep into the Syrian frontier at Tabuk in 626, brought most of the Arabian peninsula under a single authority in 630, and died of illness in June 632. Once the caliphate was founded, the first caliph, Abu Bakr (573 to 634), directed the offensives into Byzantine and Persian territory, and the second, Umar (634 to 644), consolidated the conquests with administrative and fiscal skill. The most famous soldier was Khalid ibn al-Walid, called the Sword of Syria, renowned for his horsemanship and for night marches, who led the fighting at Ajnadayn, at Damascus and at Yarmouk; Amr ibn al-As took Egypt, and Zubayr ibn al-Awwad opened the western road into it. On the Byzantine side the key figure was the emperor Heraclius, who wore the Persians down by turning back from the Mesopotamian front, retaking Antioch, driving deep into Iraq and then swinging home to Constantinople, a series of movements that broke the Sasanian state; his brother Mercurius and his son Heraclius the Younger split the command between the capital and the western front, while Ghawwar ibn al-Huwarith, chief of the Ghassanids, was in Arab eyes the lackey of the Romans. On the Sasanian side Khosrow II, Shahanshah and Peroz, grandfather, son and grandson in turn, drove that empire towards its collapse.
kits: 卡面這件秦連弩是中國弩兵體系的巔峰之作：弩臂上裝有「望山」與「機牙」，上弦時把拉力一次儲進弩機，之後每按一次機牙即發一矢，矢匣可預置十餘支，射手不必反覆上弦，故有「一踩一發」之說。戰國末年秦、韓、趙、魏諸國各自造出不同形制的連弩，漢代沿襲發展，出土的秦漢弩機可見望山、機牙、栓、弦諸件；其戰術定位在守城與野戰，以連續射擊壓住人潮與騎兵，令進攻方難以貼上城牆，明人茅元儀《武備志》仍繪有連弩圖樣。需要說明的是，這件兵器與本場戰爭相隔八百餘年，戰場在阿拉伯半島與黎凡特，秦連弩從未在此出現；當地填補同一功能位置的是別的東西：阿拉伯軍以複合反曲弓配長矛、標槍、圓盾，披鎖子甲或鱗甲，輔以雙峰駱駝馱運水與糧食；拜占庭與薩珊則有雙射角弓、全身鎧甲化的翼騎兵（kataphraktoi）、大盾，以及配重投石機、扭力弩砲、攻城塔、撞角與希臘火。647年穆阿維葉遠征君士坦丁堡時，攻城塔的木材與機械正是由腓尼基的推羅造船，再用船隊運過地中海。
kitsEn: The Qin repeating crossbow on the card is the summit piece of the Chinese crossbow system: a sight-pin and a lock are fitted to the stock, the draw is taken once and stored in the mechanism, and every pull of the lock releases a single bolt, with a magazine holding a dozen or more bolts, so that the shooter never has to re-draw the string — hence the saying that one tread brings one shot. The states of Qin, Han, Zhao and Wei each built repeating crossbows of their own form at the end of the Warring States, the Han carried the design forward, and the excavated Qin and Han locks show the sight-pin, the lock, the trigger and the string as separate parts; its tactical place was in defence, in wall and field, firing continuously to hold back masses of men and horsemen and keep an attacker from closing on the rampart, and the Wubei Zhi of the Ming writer Mao Yuanwei still carries drawings of the machine. It has to be said that this weapon stands more than eight hundred years away from this war: the fighting was in Arabia and the Levant, and the Qin repeating crossbow was never present there. What filled the same functional place locally were other things. The Arab army carried composite recurved bows with spears, javelins and round shields, wore mail or scale, and used double-humped camels to carry water and provisions. Byzantium and Persia had bow troops with double reflex bows, the fully armoured kataphraktoi cavalry, large shields, and, for siege work, counterweight trebuchets, torsion ballistae, siege towers, rams and Greek fire. When Mu'awiya marched on Constantinople in 647, the timber and machinery of the siege towers were built at Tyre in Phoenicia and then carried across the Mediterranean by ship.
tactics: 阿拉伯人在622至625年守麥地那時，用的是城砦加壕溝的守城術：627年聯軍來攻，守方在城北掘出長壕（Khandaq），以步卒列陣擋住裝甲兵與騎兵衝鋒，射手居高臨下封鎖接近路線，壕溝切斷騎兵的衝刺距離。626年塔布克遠征則是純粹的機動作戰：全軍晝夜兼程，沿途不留一兵一營、不縱兵劫掠，避免被拜占庭游騎發現，抵達希拉河一線即摧毀拜占庭前哨基地與蓄水設施，隨即回師。拜占庭對付波斯用的是另一套本領：皇帝赫拉克里乌斯以騎兵機動拖延、單騎決鬥振士氣，等到波斯主力分兵，才在627至628年集中兵力於尼尼微一役殞其根基。拉希敦的進攻則把小分隊襲擾與會戰結合：穆罕默德生前已派哈立德等率數千騎的隊伍跨境遊擊，避開拜占庭主力；634年後才逐漸集中兵力，葉爾穆克一役以步兵據山脊正面咬住敵軍，騎兵自側翼峽谷插入，切斷其退路；攻城則靠填壕、撞角、隧道與封鎖糧道，大馬士革與耶路撒冷的圍城都長達數月，耶路撒冷一次圍城即歷時約十六個月。拜占庭的防禦是縱深城市網加海防：君士坦丁堡的狄奧多西城牆長約二點五公里、高十二至十八公尺、雙層城垣，647至648年阿拉伯海軍載攻城器械入博斯普魯斯海峽時，拜占庭以快速小艇加希臘火在近菲尼基的海面燒毀其分遣船隊，迫使遠征放棄。
tacticsEn: While holding Medina from 622 to 625, the Arabs used the art of the fortified town joined to the ditch: when the coalition came against them in 627, the defenders dug a long trench to the north of the town, deployed infantry to check the armoured and the mounted charge, and posted shooters on high ground to seal the approaches, the trench cutting away the distance the horsemen needed to run up. The expedition to Tabuk in 626 was pure manoeuvre: the army marched day and night, leaving no detachment behind and no camp standing, allowing no plundering, so that Byzantine patrols would not find it; on reaching the line of the Wadi al-Rumman it destroyed the Byzantine outpost and its water works, and turned back at once. Byzantium's answer to Persia was a different craft: Heraclius used cavalry movement to hold the Persians at bay, fought single combat to hearten his men, and waited until the Persian army had scattered before concentrating his force at Nineveh in 627 and 628 to break its foundations. The Rashidun advance combined raids by small detachments with set-piece battle: before his death Muhammad had already sent men like Khalid across the frontier with several thousand riders, avoiding the Byzantine main body; only after 634 did the army concentrate, and at Yarmouk the infantry held the ridge in front while the cavalry came in through the side valleys and cut the retreats. Cities were taken by filling ditches, driving rams, tunnelling and sealing the grain road, and the sieges of Damascus and Jerusalem both ran for months, sixteen in the case of the first siege of Jerusalem. Byzantine defence was a network of cities in depth backed by sea power: the Theodosian walls of Constantinople run about two and a half kilometres, stand twelve to eighteen metres high and are doubled, and when in 647 and 648 an Arab fleet carried siege machinery into the Bosporus, Byzantine fast galleys met the detached squadrons with Greek fire off Phoenix and burned most of them, and the expedition was called off.
data: 可據以寫下的數字大致如下。希吉拉時隨行穆罕默德的只數十人，麥地那社群一年之內亦不過數百，到632年他去世時，結盟的部落與居民已達數萬之眾。626年塔布克遠征，阿拉伯軍的傳統記述是三千人（其中騎兵約九百），對手是加瓦爾所率的拜占庭與加沙尼聯軍，一般估計在八千至三萬之間；阿拉伯史家稱聯軍幾乎全滅、僅十數人逃回，此數顯係敘事誇大，不可當作統計，但聯軍損失慘重、拜占庭丟掉大批攻城器材與工程兵則是可信的。630年阿拉伯半島基本統一時，軍力仍以萬計；634年後進入敘利亞的軍隊據稱約一萬，其後增至二萬五千至三萬五千。636年葉爾穆克戰役，拜占庭方面常記為五萬至八萬，阿拉伯方面二萬五千至三萬五千，學界多認為拜占庭的數字被敵方史家誇大。637至639年耶路撒冷先圍城約十六個月而失敗，再圍而克之，守軍依當時安排繳納贖金後得准撤出。647至648年君士坦丁堡之圍，穆阿維葉提出的方案是兩萬騎兵與五萬步兵，拜占庭守軍各說法在八千至一萬五千之間；拜占庭海軍在近菲尼基的接戰中以希臘火焚毀阿拉伯分遣船隊的大部分。
dataEn: The figures that can be set down with some warrant are roughly these. Only a few dozen people followed Muhammad on the Hijra, and the community at Medina numbered a few hundred within the year; by the time he died in 632 the tribes and inhabitants bound to him ran to tens of thousands. At the expedition to Tabuk in 626 the traditional Arab figure for the army is three thousand, of whom about nine hundred were cavalry, against a Byzantine and Ghassanid coalition under Ghawwar generally estimated at between eight thousand and thirty thousand; the Arab chroniclers say the coalition was wiped out with a dozen survivors, a figure plainly inflated as narrative and not to be treated as a statistic, but the severity of the coalition's losses and the loss of Byzantine siege matériel and engineers are credible. When the peninsula was brought together in 630 the army still numbered in the thousands; the force that entered Syria after 634 is put at about ten thousand, and later at twenty-five to thirty-five thousand. At Yarmouk in 636 the Byzantine side is commonly given as fifty to eighty thousand against twenty-five to thirty-five thousand on the Arab side, and scholars generally hold that the Byzantine figure was inflated by enemy chroniclers. Jerusalem was besieged for about sixteen months between 637 and 639 and failed the first time, and was taken the second; the garrison was allowed to withdraw on the terms then agreed, against payment. In the siege of Constantinople in 647 and 648 the plan put forward by Mu'awiya was twenty thousand horse and fifty thousand foot, against Byzantine garrisons put by different sources at between eight thousand and fifteen thousand; the Byzantine fleet, meeting the detached Arab squadrons off Phoenix, burned most of them with Greek fire.
cause: 這場戰爭的第一因在麥加。麥加的氏族貴族不肯接受穆罕默德所宣講的一神信仰與清除偶像的說法，兩派矛盾激化到武裝對抗；622年初聯盟一度圍困麥地那，逼迫信仰者出走的呼聲直接催生了希吉拉，把一個宗派問題變成了一場建國運動。第二因是部落之間的宿怨與商路：麥地那控制著阿拉伯半島北部的南北商道，哈立德一族與麥加商團在銅礦與香路利益上的衝突不斷加深，而敘利亞的商路與稅收長期由羅馬—拜占庭與薩珊角力。第三因是國際局勢：拜占庭與薩珊自602年起打了二十六年，波斯奪去埃及與敘利亞，拜占庭又自佩羅斯戰線反打回去，628年波斯在宮變中內爆，632年王位爭奪把這個帝國推向崩潰。兩個大國都精疲力竭之際，一支剛剛完成部落聯盟的軍隊出現在邊境。此外，阿拉伯史家還記載過拜占庭皇帝在622至623年間派使節到麥地那勸降、許以敘利亞的權位，試圖在宗教議題之外用交易換取阿拉伯人的中立。
causeEn: The first cause of this war lay in Mecca. The clans of the city would not accept the monotheistic teaching of Muhammad or his call to clear away the idols, and the conflict between the two sides passed into armed strife; early in 622 the Meccan coalition besieged Medina, and the call to leave the town for exile was itself the push that produced the Hijra and turned a sectarian quarrel into a movement of state-building. The second cause lay in tribal feuds and the caravan roads: Medina held the north-south trade routes of the peninsula, and the quarrel between the Khazraj and the Meccan merchant clans over copper and the incense routes kept deepening, while the trade and the tolls of Syria had for long been fought over by the Roman and Byzantine state on one side and Persia on the other. The third cause was the international situation. Byzantium and Persia had been fighting since 602 for twenty-six years; Persia had taken Egypt and Syria, and Byzantium had struck back from the Persian front, and the Persian state burst apart internally in a palace coup in 628, while the struggles over the throne in 632 pushed the empire towards collapse. With both great powers exhausted, an army that had just completed the uniting of the tribes appeared on the frontier. The Arab chroniclers add, moreover, that between 622 and 623 the Byzantine emperor sent an embassy to Medina to argue for submission and offered rule over Syria, trying to buy the neutrality of the Arabs by a bargain outside the religious question.
impact: 這場戰爭的直接後果，是阿拉伯世界從來沒有過的一種政體被建立並存活下來：哈里發國、伊斯蘭曆與以《古蘭經》為核心的共同體，自622年元旦起算，影響至今的全球計時。拜占庭則付出慘重代價：敘利亞與耶路撒冷淪陷、642年埃及失守、647至648年君士坦丁堡之圍無功而返，此後它的國策明顯轉向以海軍、希臘火與首都城牆為核心的防禦，717至718年那場慘勝的圍城，成為此後數百年的東地中海格局底色；同一時期赫拉克里乌斯迎回「天降」的聖像，令基督教國教地位在拜占庭被鞏固，而耶路撒冷自638年起改由阿拉伯人治理，聖地三教並存的局面就此成形。另一端的連鎖反應是薩珊的崩潰：631至632年拜占庭與阿拉伯先後出兵，波斯王都被殺，帝國在一個世紀內被完全吸收。更遠處看，伊斯蘭教與阿拉伯語隨軍隊與商人向東進入中亞與印度、向西進入北非與伊比里亞，促成醫學、數學與天文知識的跨洲傳遞；同時在東亞，唐太宗貞觀年間玄奘於629年西行取經，正是沿著這條被重新打通的絲路走。
impactEn: The immediate consequence of this war was the creation of a form of state that the Arab world had never known, and which survived: the caliphate, the Islamic calendar, and a community organised around the Qur'an, reckoned from the first of Muharram in 622, still governs the counting of time across the world. Byzantium paid a heavy price: Syria and Jerusalem were lost, Egypt fell in 642, and the siege of Constantinople in 647 and 648 achieved nothing, after which its policy turned visibly towards a defence built on the navy, Greek fire and the walls of the capital — the costly victory of the siege of 717 and 718 became the fixed pattern of the eastern Mediterranean for centuries to come; in the same years Heraclius brought the supposedly heaven-sent icon back to Constantinople, confirming the place of the Christian state church in Byzantium, while Jerusalem, under Arab rule from 638, completed the arrangement in which three religions shared the Holy City. The chain reaction on the other side was the destruction of the Sasanians: Byzantium and the Arabs struck in turn in 631 and 632, the Persian king was killed in the fighting, and the empire was wholly absorbed within a century. Further out, Islam and Arabic travelled with the armies and the merchants east into Central Asia and India and west into North Africa and Iberia, carrying medicine, mathematics and astronomy across continents; and in East Asia, Xuanzang set out west from Chang'an to seek scriptures in 629, in the Zhenguan years of Emperor Taizong of Tang, following a Silk Road that had just been opened again.
result: 就622至630年這一段而言，結果是清楚的：麥地那社群活了下來，希吉拉成為伊斯蘭曆的元年，阿拉伯半島在630年基本統一，穆罕默德在632年6月去世時留下的是一個已經成型的聯盟國家與一支遠征過敘利亞邊境的軍隊；628年阿拉伯與拜占庭還短暫簽下停戰，一度聯手對付薩珊，坐實了兩個帝國兩敗俱傷而阿拉伯漁翁得利的格局。但真正的較量才剛開始：634年之後拉希敦大軍進入拜占庭的敘利亞，636年葉爾穆克一役定下大局，637至639年耶路撒冷陷落，642年埃及淪陷，647至648年君士坦丁堡之圍以海軍失利收場，阿拉伯第一次攻入博斯普魯斯海峽的嘗試就此終結，此後要等到717至718年才再試一次。對卡面這件秦連弩而言，結論是它並不在這場戰爭的現場：它代表的是守城一方以儲力連發的弩機壓住進攻者的思路，而真正留在這段檔案裡的，是阿拉伯弓兵、攻城塔、配重投石機與拜占庭的希臘火。
resultEn: For the stretch from 622 to 630 the outcome is clear. The community of Medina survived; the Hijra became year one of the Islamic calendar; the Arabian peninsula was brought together by 630; and when Muhammad died in June 632 he left behind a confederate state already formed and an army that had campaigned on the Syrian frontier. In 628 the Arabs and the Byzantines even signed a short truce and turned together against the Sasanians, confirming the pattern in which two empires bleed each other and the Arab coalition takes the prize. But the real contest was only beginning. After 634 the Rashidun armies entered Byzantine Syria; the battle of Yarmouk in 636 decided matters; Jerusalem fell between 637 and 639; Egypt was lost in 642; and the siege of Constantinople in 647 and 648 ended in a naval defeat, closing for good the first attempt to carry the war into the Bosporus, with the next attempt not to come until 717 and 718. As for the Qin repeating crossbow on the card, the conclusion is that it was not on this field: what it stands for is the principle of a defending side pressing the attacker with a stored-power repeating lock, and what actually survives in the record of these years is the Arab bow line, the siege tower, the counterweight trebuchet, and the Greek fire of Byzantium.
